im-c53-01.h: -(으)ㄹ까 하다 (Casual Tentative Plan) vs -고자 (Formal Public Purpose)

a.d: Used when pondering a personal plan that is not yet fully fixed. Mild and flexible in everyday conversations.
ex: 주말에는 집에서 푹 쉬면서 책이나 **읽을까 해요**. / I'm thinking of just resting at home and reading a book this weekend.

b.d: Used in formal speeches, presentations, or announcements to state a firm objective ('with the intention to').
ex: 새로운 사업 방향에 대한 의견을 **듣고자** 간담회를 마련하였습니다. / We arranged this roundtable in order to listen to opinions on the new business direction.

im-c53-01.tip: Use -(으)ㄹ까 하다 for casual personal pondering; use -고자 for official speeches, reports, and formal events.

im-c53-01.q: Fix the unnatural sentence that awkwardly uses the high-formality expression -고자 in casual conversation with a friend.
im-c53-01.wrong: 주말에 서점에 가서 소설책을 사고자 해.
answers: 주말에 서점에 가서 소설책을 살까 해.
주말에 서점에 가서 소설책을 살까 해
주말에 서점에 가서 소설책을 사려고 해.
주말에 서점에 가서 소설책을 사려고 해
im-c53-01.hint: When telling a friend about a casual, unfixed plan, use -살까 해 or -사려고 해.
im-c53-01.why: -고자 is strictly reserved for formal speeches, writing, and business events, making it unnatural among close friends.

im-c53-02.h: -(으)려던 참이다 (Immediate Matching Timing) vs -(으)ㄹ 겸 (Achieving Dual Purposes)

a.h: -(으)려던 참이다 (Just about to do that exact thing)
a.d: Used when the speaker was already on the verge of performing the action right when prompted by the listener.
ex: 안 그래도 지금 막 커피 한잔 **마시려던 참이었어요**. / Coincidentally, I was just about to drink a cup of coffee.

b.d: Used when engaging in one action to accomplish two or more distinct purposes ('kill two birds with one stone').
ex: 운동도 **할 겸** 바람도 **쐴 겸** 공원에 나왔어요. / I came out to the park to get some exercise and catch some fresh air.

im-c53-02.tip: Use -(으)려던 참이다 to match immediate timing; use -(으)ㄹ 겸 when balancing multiple simultaneous purposes.

im-c53-02.q: Fix the unnatural sentence that incorrectly uses -(으)려던 참에 to list dual purposes of an outing.
im-c53-02.wrong: 친구도 만나려던 참에 바람도 쐴 겸 시내에 나갔어요.
answers: 친구도 만날 겸 바람도 쐴 겸 시내에 나갔어요.
친구도 만날 겸 바람도 쐴 겸 시내에 나갔어요
친구도 만날 겸 바람도 쐬러 시내에 나갔어요.
친구도 만날 겸 바람도 쐬러 시내에 나갔어요
im-c53-02.hint: When stating dual intentions accomplished together, balance them with -(으)ㄹ 겸: 만날 겸.
im-c53-02.why: Dual purposes require the parallel structure -(으)ㄹ 겸 -(으)ㄹ 겸, not -(으)려던 참이다.

im-c53-03.h: -아/어야지요 (Firm Self-Resolution / Moral Admonition) vs -(으)ㄹ까 하다 (Gentle Possibility)

a.d: Used for resolute self-promises or admonishing someone gently about proper courtesy and duty.
ex: 새해에는 야식을 끊고 건강을 **챙겨야지요**. / In the new year, I must cut out late-night snacks and look after my health.

b.d: Used when contemplating a simple casual option without any obligation or firm resolution.
ex: 내일은 날씨가 맑으면 빨래를 **할까 해요**. / Tomorrow if the weather is clear, I'm thinking of doing laundry.

im-c53-03.tip: Use -아/어야지요 (-아/어야지) for firm resolutions and natural obligations; use -(으)ㄹ까 하다 for casual maybes.

im-c53-03.q: Fix the weak sentence that mistakenly uses the tentative form -(으)ㄹ까 해 when firmly resolving to stop procrastinating.
im-c53-03.wrong: 오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 말고 끝낼까 해.
answers: 오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 말고 끝내야지.
오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 말고 끝내야지
오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 말고 끝내야지요.
오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 말고 끝내야지요
im-c53-03.hint: When making a firm self-resolution to overcome bad habits, use -끝내야지.
im-c53-03.why: Firm self-discipline and resolution to finish tasks require -아/어야지 rather than hesitant pondering.

im-c53-03.sample: 약속 시간에 늦었으면 먼저 사과부터 해야지요.
im-c53-03.why: Expressing proper courtesy and admonition with -해야지요.

ko: 연말이 다가오자 수진 씨는 올 한 해 미뤄 둔 일들을 떠올렸습니다.
'새해에는 게으름 피우지 말고 아침마다 운동해야지' 하며 다짐했지요.
옆에서 듣던 선배도 '건강이 제일이니 꼭 그렇게 실천해야지요'라며 격려해 주었습니다.
en: As the year-end approached, Sujin recalled the tasks she had postponed throughout the year.
She made a firm resolution, 'In the new year, I must not be lazy and exercise every morning.'
Hearing this nearby, her senior encouraged her saying, 'Health comes first, so you should definitely put that into practice.'

im-c53-03.q: What self-resolution did Sujin make for the coming new year?
options: Exercising every morning without being lazy
Buying an expensive sports car
Sleeping until noon every day
im-c53-03.why: The passage states: '새해에는 게으름 피우지 말고 아침마다 운동해야지 하며 다짐했지요'.

im-c53-03.q: How did Sujin's senior encourage her resolution?
options: Affirming that health is top priority and she should put it into practice
Mocking her for making unrealistic plans
Telling her to cancel her gym membership
im-c53-03.why: The senior said: '건강이 제일이니 꼭 그렇게 실천해야지요라며 격려해 주었습니다'.

a.d: Used to convey an unconfirmed plan gently without creating premature commitments.
ex: 이번 방학에는 운전면허를 **딸까 해요**. / I'm thinking of getting a driver's license this vacation.

b.d: Used when the speaker was already poised to take action just as the other party brings it up.
ex: 점심 먹으러 가자고요? 안 그래도 막 **나가려던 참이었어요**! / Go eat lunch? I was just about to head out anyway!

im-c53-04.tip: Use -(으)ㄹ까 하다 for broad future possibilities; use -(으)려던 참이다 for immediate moment-to-moment synergy.

ko: 유진 씨는 오늘 업무를 시작하며 '오전 중에 보고서를 끝내야지' 하고 마음먹었습니다.

She had never seen the document before
She refused to print it out

im-c53-04.q: What did Yujin propose to her colleague on the way home?

Canceling all future meetings
